name: Auto Tech
old_description: With decades of experience under the hood, Auto Tech of Jackson Hole gets you back on the road - fast!
about:
Auto Tech of Jackson Hole operates in Jackson, Wyoming, where it has served the Teton Valley for many years. The shop came under new ownership in recent years when Levi Shervin, a technician with decades of experience in the area, took over the business. Shervin’s background in the valley’s automotive needs shaped the shop’s focus on honest, affordable car care for local drivers.

The facility provides a full range of automotive repair and maintenance services. Technicians handle check-engine-light diagnostics, brake repair, battery testing and replacement, wheel alignment, oil and fluid changes, emissions testing, suspension work, tune-ups, general maintenance, towing, and seasonal winterizing. The shop services all vehicle types and emphasizes getting customers back on the road quickly.

Primary customers are residents and businesses in Teton County who rely on personal and commercial vehicles for daily transportation. The shop’s service list reflects the demands of a mountain climate, with particular attention to winter readiness and safety inspections.

Shervin states that the business was rebuilt around transparent consulting and pricing that won’t leave drivers stranded, and that winter safety remains a top priority for every vehicle that enters the bay.
built_on: Winter safety as a top priority
Decades of local experience under owner Levi Shervin
